package.name: paper-writing-studio
package.upstream_inspiration: ref/nature-writing-studio plus local IEEE and Elsevier Zotero-derived materials

upstream_sync.nature: read-only source snapshot; verify source provenance before refresh

intent.description: Use this academic writing skill to polish or translate academic writing with an explicit Nature, IEEE, Elsevier, or neutral profile. Selects a profile by explicit venue, journal allowlist, then unambiguous domain; reports uncertainty instead of guessing.
intent.job_to_be_done: Polish academic prose with an explicit venue profile while preserving evidence-bearing tokens.

qiaomu_defaults.language: Chinese-first documentation with English prose output
qiaomu_defaults.candidate_rows: report but never promote to applied rules

should_trigger: 按 Nature 风格润色 abstract，保留数字和引用。
Rewrite the IEEE Transactions introduction and keep evidence tokens.
按 Elsevier 过程控制论文改写 experiments。
把这段学术英文润色成中性风格，保护数字和引用。
按 Nature 风格润色整篇 manuscript，保持引用和数字不变。
中译英学术写作润色这段 Results，保留证据 token。
Polish the academic English of this full manuscript with an IEEE profile.
should_not_trigger: 请编译 LaTeX 并检查双栏排版。
请安装字体并生成投稿模板。
请检查参考文献格式和期刊模板，不要改写正文。
未经授权把润色结果输出文件 manuscript.md。
near_neighbor: 请总结这篇论文的研究结论。
请诊断 Python 环境中的依赖冲突。

evidence_boundary.public_claim_policy: claim only what local validation, install proof, human review, or provider-backed evidence actually supports
